subject: Hylian Loach
text: The loach's spawn is not random; a memory bit counts paid fishing attempts.

evidence.quote: It is not random. There is a bit in memory that tracks how many times you have paid for fishing.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: When the paid count is divisible by 3, the pool holds 17 fish for child and 16 for adult.

evidence.quote: If that number is divisible by 3, then the number of fish that spawn in the pool is 17 for child & 16 for adult (Fish ID 16 & 17 are both loach. Yes, two loaches will spawn as child).

subject: Hylian Loach
text: The loach spawns right after entering the area following 3 paid visits.

evidence.quote: Note that it spawns immediately upon entering the area after paying 3 times.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: The fishing counter only increases when you pay for fishing, not when you enter the area.

evidence.quote: Note the counter only increments when you pay for fishing, not when entering the area.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: The paid-fishing counter persists from the start of the save file and is not reset by resetting the game.

evidence.quote: That bit is tracked from the very beginning of the save file, it does not go back to zero when you reset the game.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: The same paid-fishing counter is shared by child and adult Link and is not reset when changing ages.

evidence.quote: Also, the same bit is incremented for Child & Adult and does not reset when changing ages.

subject: Water Temple
text: Save the game in the Water Temple, the closest respawn point, before retrying the loach.

evidence.quote: Go save the game inside the Water Temple (the closest respawn point)

subject: Fishing
text: A commenter reports that holding Down R+A catches any fish.

evidence.quote: Man, you really can just catch ANY fish by holding Down R+A.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: Pay 3 times and leave so the loach spawns, then on the fourth visit use the sinking lure at the lily pads near the logs.

evidence.quote: My advice for getting this one kinda quick is do the cycle of paying three times and leave, so the loach spawn and the fourth time, then go immediately for the sinking lure, run to the lily pads that are near the logs and try your best shot, because you can barely see the fish that are underneath, have in mind that YOU CAN ONLY GET THE LOACH WHEN IT IS IN THOSE LILYPADS.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: A commenter says the loach can only be caught while it is in the lily pads.

evidence.quote: have in mind that YOU CAN ONLY GET THE LOACH WHEN IT IS IN THOSE LILYPADS.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: Stand on the log, throw into the lily pads, and lure the fish out with soft tugs.

evidence.quote: you need to stand on the log and throw into the lilipads then lure the fish out from underneath them with soft tugs

subject: Hylian Loach
text: If the loach runs to the middle, waiting 10-20 minutes may make it swim back for a new chance.

evidence.quote: you can catch it even if it's run to the middle... I believe waiting 10-20 mins makes it swim back to give you a new chance

subject: Hylian Loach
text: The loach is always on the left side near the water lettuce.

evidence.quote: This fish is always on the left side near the water lettuce.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: Hold A while casting to the left with the joystick held left so the fish do not let go.

evidence.quote: The best part for you to catch all the fish without them letting go is to hold down the A button on the controller while placing the fishing rod to the left, keeping the joystick to the left.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: The loach looks shadowier than normal fish, which helps spot it in the water.

evidence.quote: It's hard to see the fish thanks to the overly-thick texturing of the water but you can sorta tell if its there by it having a more shadow-ey look to it compared to the normal fish.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: Save-state method: save as you enter, confirm the loach spawned near the left lily pads, then load and cast immediately.

evidence.quote: Save the state as you walk through the door, confirm the spawn near the left lily pads. Load the state.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: Reload the save state if the loach fails or is spooked.

evidence.quote: If you fail/ spook him, reload the state.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: The loach appears on the fourth consecutive paid entry at the 20-rupee pond, then at the 8th and 12th paid visits.

evidence.quote: The Hylian Loach appears on the fourth time Link enters the fishing pond and pays the 20-rupee fee consecutively. After that it appear at 8th, 12th, etc., paid visits.

subject: Fishing Pond
text: Go to the fishing pond at Lake Hylia to start the loach attempt.

evidence.quote: 1. Go to the fishing pond at Lake Hylia

subject: Fishing Pond
text: Pay for a fishing round and quit, repeating the buy-and-quit cycle.

evidence.quote: 2. Buy for a fishing round and quit, buy and quit, buy and quit

subject: Fishing Pond
text: Leave the pond area back to Lake Hylia and save the game.

evidence.quote: 3. Leave the pond area back to Lake Hylia and SAVE

subject: Fishing Pond
text: Re-enter the pond without saving, reload if the catch goes wrong, and pay a 4th time.

evidence.quote: 4. Re-enter the pond area (DON'T save anymore now and RELOAD if smth went wrong with the catching attempt) and pay a 4th time

subject: Hylian Loach
text: On the left side of the lake, go a little into the pond and use Z-target to check whether the loach is there.

evidence.quote: 5. Go to the left side of the lake and notice the grass sticking out a bit further into the pond, go a little bit into the pond and use Z-target to try and see if the Loach is there

subject: Hylian Loach
text: Wiggle the lure until a fish bites; let the first 2 bites escape until only the loach remains in the area.

evidence.quote: 6. Wiggle your lure a few times till a fish bites (it's usually not the loach first, so careful and let the first 2 bites escape by having them bite from the wiggling and then not doing ANYTHING) and do this until only the loach is in that area

subject: Hylian Loach
text: Z-target the loach and wiggle the lure without reeling in until it bites.

evidence.quote: 7. Z-target again and try to get the loach to bite by wiggling as much as you can (no reeling in) until it bites

subject: Hylian Loach
text: When the loach bites, hold reel-in and tilt the analog stick toward the fish's head, pausing movement while it jumps or makes dust clouds.

evidence.quote: 8. WHEN it finally bites, immediately press the button for reeling in and hold it till you did so, meanwhile, tilt your analog stick in the direction the fish's head is looking right now and adjust it every time, stop the analog stick movements while it jumps and also go a bit more easy on it/no moving when it produces these dust clouds underwater.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: Keep retrying and reload the save if something goes wrong; expect about 2 hours or less.

evidence.quote: 9. Keep doing the above and reload the save if smth goes wrong and you'll get it in about 2 hours or less, hopefully! <3

subject: Hylian Loach
text: Use the Iron Boots and Zora Tunic to locate and track the loach underwater.

evidence.quote: Iron Boots + Zora tunic to locate and track it underwater

subject: Hylian Loach
text: As adult Link, use the Iron Boots to find the loach, then go to a good spot to try catching it.

evidence.quote: i find its easy to try as adult link, use the iron boots to look for where the loach is, then, go to an ideal spot to try and catch it.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: If the loach is startled, give up and return 4 times; do not hook another fish, and no special lure is needed.

evidence.quote: If startle it, give up and come back 4 times again. Do not hook up another fish or you will startle it. There is no need for special lure.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: Keep the analog fishing rod to the left and hold the action button to prevent the fish from getting away.

evidence.quote: you need to keep the analog fishing rod to the left and hold the action button; doing this will prevent the fish from getting away.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: The loach sometimes moves near the surface by the lily pads, close to land.

evidence.quote: At some point the hylian loach randomly moved close to the surface of the water near the lily pads very close to land.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: When the loach is stationary, stand far away, line up without Z-targeting, and cast the sinking lure right on top of it.

evidence.quote: While it was stationary, i just stood very far away, lined myself up to where the hylian loach is, no Z-targeting and threw the sinking lure in the water right on top of it, eventually it hooked and I held down on the analog stick + A

subject: Hylian Loach
text: A commenter reports the loach is very hard to catch when it is near a school of other fish.

evidence.quote: Literally impossible to catch if its near a whole school of fish

subject: Hylian Loach
text: The loach ignores the bait unless it has headed toward the lily pads, so wait for it to go there.

evidence.quote: I feel it's necessary to wait for him to head towards the lily pads; otherwise, I think he ignores the bait.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: Stay underwater in Iron Boots and Zora Tunic and wait for the loach to go to the lily pads.

evidence.quote: You can just stay underwater and wait for him to go to the lily pads wearing the Iron Boots and Zora Tunic.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: The loach often breaks the line, and it is picky about biting while other fish follow the lure.

evidence.quote: This took me many restarts as the loach keeps breaking the line randomly.
It's hard to get it to bite since the loach is picky, and the other fish nearby always follow at the same time.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: Lead a nearby fish to you, then run at it after reeling in to scare it away so only the loach remains.

evidence.quote: My trick was to lead a fish close to me and right as I finish reeling, I run towards the fish to scare it off somewhere else so that it's just me and the loach for a while.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: Baiting the loach while it sits still on the lake bottom failed; it reacted quickly once it moved back under the leaves.

evidence.quote: Well, apparently my mistake was that I kept trying to bait it when it stayed and never moved from the bottom of the lake, only when it went back under the leaves it finally almost immediately reacted.

subject: Sinking Lure
text: The sinking lure can be used as a retry option after a failed loach attempt.

evidence.quote: There is the sinking lure as well, so you can give it a shot in case you screwed up trying to catch the Loach.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: If the loach is not visible, pay for fishing and leave, repeating until it appears.

evidence.quote: If you don't see the loach, pay, and then leave. Repeat until you find it.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: Once the loach is seen, do not pay again; leave the fishing hole immediately.

evidence.quote: Once you find it, DON'T PAY, just immediately leave the fishing hole.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: If the loach gets off the hook, reset the game; you respawn in the Water Temple and the loach returns on the first entry.

evidence.quote: If you fail & it gets off the hook, reset the game. You will respawn in the Water Temple and the loach will be back the first time you enter.

subject: Hylian Loach
text: If the loach moves away, repeat the pay-and-leave cycle so it spawns again on the fourth time.

evidence.quote: If it moves your best option is resetting the cycle of paying and leaving three times again, so it spawn the fourth time.
